description: Creates a snapshot of a Cognigy.AI project. Snapshots capture the entire project configuration (flows, intents, endpoints, etc.) for backup or deployment. MUTATING: Set dryRun=false to create. Async operation - polls until complete.

description.description: Optional description of what this snapshot contains or why it was created

dryRun.description: If true (default), validates without creating. Set to false to actually create the snapshot.

pollIntervalMs.description: How often to check task status (1-10 seconds, default 3)

projectId.description: The project ID to create a snapshot of

timeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for snapshot creation (5-600 seconds, default 120)

name: create_snapshot
